items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1957-04-11
items.q: Then Charlie Skeet, we got rid of him and got Claude Hopkins in the band.

ctx.x: Well, different bands, I worked with quite a few different bands. I worked with, let's see, can I get them in rotation? When you first got there, I was thinking about you. When I first got there, well, I went there with Ross's band. We only stayed on the job about two weeks. Then I went into a dancing school with another, by the way it was a piano player down in Florida that was in New York. He went to New York with this Broadway gentleman. So when we got to New York and working at a big place like the Roseland,…
Then Charlie Skeet, we got rid of him and got Claude Hopkins in the band.

That's how that started, Claude Hopkins band. That's how that started and went to the Savoy Ballroom, pretty good band. So when they hired us in the Savoy Ballroom, Chick Webb Band was at the Savoy, so they went down to the Roseland Mall. So happened to the manager, happened to come in to Savoy and he said you'd rather have Claude Hopkins band than Chick Webb Band. That's how we got into the Roseland Mall. We Claude Hopkins band. Do you know Geechee Fields? Traumhole player? Traumhole player. Yeah, I don't know…
